== Summary ==
Logo of the [[Players Committee]]: the horizontal lockup of the STAR WARS Customizable Card Game mark beside the words PLAYERS COMMITTEE, the header logo of starwarsccg.org since 2013 (the current copy is ''logo.jpg'' on the [https://www.starwarsccg.org/about-us/ About Us] page).
* '''Source:''' [https://web.archive.org/web/20170102165052im_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2013/03/logo.png wp-content/uploads/2013/03/logo.png] at starwarsccg.org (Internet Archive capture of 2 January 2017; the same lockup is in the header of the [https://web.archive.org/web/20131214011308/http://starwarsccg.org/ 14 December 2013 capture]; retrieved 10 October 2026).
* '''Processing:''' none (transparent PNG as archived).

== Licensing ==
Logo of the Players Committee, shown for identification in the article [[Players Committee]]. Rights remain with their owners.
